title: Supply Chain Glossary

prov.label: SIMULATED · would derive from: logistics standard operating procedures, EDI implementation guides, WMS training curriculum, engineered-labor standards manual

rows: Advance Ship Notice (EDI 856) — vendor's pre-shipment manifest down to carton/LPN; drives receipt pre-build at the DC
Functional Acknowledgment — machine receipt for any EDI document; missing 997 within 24 h triggers auto-resend
License Plate Number — barcode identity for a pallet or carton; the unit the WMS tracks from receipt to pick face
The forward slot an SKU is picked from; assignment is owned by slotting, replenished from reserve locations
Assigning SKUs to pick faces to minimize travel and ergonomic strain; re-solved weekly from 13-week velocity
A batched release of pick work for a shipping window; gen1/gen2 DCs build ≈6 waves a day
Continuous order release without batching — gen3 pilot model; tasks drip-fed as capacity frees
Receipt flows door-to-door without putaway; pre-allocated to store orders from the ASN
Offer of a load to a carrier (EDI 204); acceptance is contractual and starts the tracking clock
Carrier charge when a trailer is held past free time at a dock or yard; minimized by appointment compliance
Short-haul container move from port or rail ramp to the DC; dispatched against terminal pre-alerts
Importer Security Filing due to CBP 24 h before vessel load; misses carry a $5K penalty per shipment
Over, Short & Damaged — receipt discrepancy versus the ASN; opens a vendor claim and holds the PO line
The running per-DC on-hand ledger updated by every receipt, move, pick, and adjustment
Time allowance for a DC task derived from MOST analysis; the denominator of incentive pay
Gen1 batch file of orders/items pushed from shared services to the COBOL WMS; the inverse is RF upload
